items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: His son Manuel, the fella that's a professor today. He played with me too.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. One of those. One of the guys.

Played one of them tubas. Now, his son too, you know. His son Manuel, the fella that's a professor today. He played with me too. He's living. Manuel, ain't he living? Who? Manuel Alexander. Manuel Alexander.
You told me you met him, yeah. I don't know. I've never seen him.
